rca of the issue: Reported bug 'PRICE OF DMCC IS WRONG': DMCC's 'FROM AED 1,925' came from an AstroLabs partner co-working listing that had been imported into the packages collection, and an 'Uptown Homeowners Package' at AED 0 was also present, along with 2-Year and 3-Year term duplicates. Fix (E1): added PACKAGE_EXCLUSIONS ({DMCC: [AstroLabs Package, Uptown Homeowners Package]}) and DURATION_ALLOWLIST ({DMCC: {'1 Year'}}) plus a _apply_data_quality() run at the end of ensure_defaults() that deactivates or filters those rows and force-flips any surviving zero-price row to pricing_mode='on_request'. Verified end-to-end: /free-zones DMCC card = AED 10,345 (was 1,925), /free-zones/dmcc detail shows 12 one-year packages ranging Nook 10,345 → Jump Start 43,780 (offer 39,402), no AED 0 / AED 1,925 / AED NaN / AstroLabs / Uptown / 2-Year / 3-Year anywhere. Idempotent on restart (subsequent seeds log excluded/duration_hidden/on_request = 0). Total active packages = 118 (126 − 8 DMCC exclusions), other zones unchanged.
